featured_reviews.name: hormuzd daruwalla
featured_reviews.review_text: We bought the S25 Ultra from Samsung store at Shiftlink. Amit, the salesman did a fabulous job and made the entire buying process so seamless. He was empathetic and understanding. Thanks Amit for helping us..

featured_reviews.name: Punit Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
I wish Google allowed Negative Ratings!

Samsung set extremely high standards on my first purchase, however, it was one of the most torturous, horrifying and harrowing purchase the 2nd time. Staff talk sweeter than sugar to sell a product, but here comes the classic scene. Mr. Amit ran into miscalculation of the total value, under billing. I had to correct his total - 2 times! Lol...

Now, he bills me for the insurance for the phone, and says it is a "backend" procedure which will take time, so you can leave and within few hours you'll receive the confirmation. With such confidence, I leave and immediately flew out for my work. After 2.5 weeks I suddenly realize that the insurance wasn't active nor any correspondence from Samsung! With courage I call the store and speak with Mr. Amit who now says he has forgotten to do it, and it's our "backend" fault and it should be active within a day.

Few days later, I receive a WhatsApp from him instructing me to take photos of the phone in different angles and send to him for insurance.  On asking him, what's the status - it's in process at "backend".

So funny, after sending him the images,about 10 days pass - no response, nothing! It's still at the "backend" and in process. I thought it's more like diarrhoea when I heard "backend".

Then one fine day the big boss from Samsung Mr. Mohnish Reddy calls me, giving big talks and assuring it will be active today by 12noon, and hereby confirming that if it isn't active - refund with compensation and penalties shall be given back to me.

Nothing yet - I called him at 2.30pm - he says - it's under process and you will receive email in 30 mins. Inspite of me demanding for my refund, false assurance.

3.45pm - Mr. Rahul - his super boss joins the call! It's already executed from "backend" and should be active any second! Lol.... Sounded like an insurance scam!

Samsung and this store! Guys... Honest feedback - stay away from them. Take the money first and disappear!! No responsibility, no loyalty and no decency. All these guys spoke to me with such arrogance, attitude and felt humiliated after paying for such an expensive phone!

Those you really read reviews and visit place - this one is for them!

featured_reviews.name: Amit Patkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I purchased a Blue Star Air Conditioner from Vijay Sales, expecting timely installation and reliable after-sales support. Unfortunately, my experience has been extremely disappointing.

Since the purchase, I have had to make numerous follow-up calls regarding the installation and service. Despite repeated attempts to contact the concerned team, I have not received any satisfactory response. Every time I call, I am simply told that it will take more time, without any clear commitment or resolution.

What is most frustrating is that, at the time of purchase, the sales representative assured me that the installation would be completed promptly. However, after the sale was completed, no one took responsibility for addressing my concerns or providing proper updates.

The lack of communication, poor customer service, and failure to honor commitments have made this one of the worst retail experiences I have encountered. I strongly advise prospective customers to carefully consider the quality of after-sales service before purchasing any product from this showroom.

I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and improves its customer support standards.

I am deeply disappointed with Apple’s customer service at the store. I have been visiting the store for the last two days, and today alone I visited twice, only for a simple service report and repair quotation for my phone.

What followed was nothing short of harassment.

Each time, I was asked to wait for more than an hour, with no clarity, no ownership, and no respect for the customer’s time. After making me sit there endlessly, the final response was a casual “nahi ho payega”—as if wasting hours of a customer’s life is completely acceptable.

This is not premium service. This is making a fool of customers.

Apple charges premium prices and advertises world-class service, but the ground reality is extremely disappointing. There was no accountability, no proper explanation, and zero professionalism. If the work cannot be done, say it clearly at the beginning—don’t keep customers waiting for hours like they have nothing better to do.

This experience has completely shaken my trust in Apple’s after-sales service. If this is how Apple treats its customers, then the brand image is clearly surviving only on marketing, not actual service quality.

Very poor experience. Would NOT recommend this service center to anyone.

featured_reviews.name: Pratik Thakare
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently bought an HP Victus 15, and Mr. Arvind helped me through the whole process. He patiently answered all my questions and helped me narrow down my options without trying to upsell features I didn’t need.

The store also beat Chroma’s price. What stood out even more was that they were able to clearly answer a few questions that Chroma had actually given me incorrect information about while pushing me toward Lenovo or Dell.

The biggest thing for me was how helpful they were during payment. My credit cards kept failing and after about 8 attempts it was getting frustrating, but they didn’t rush me or ask me to come back another day. Instead, they split the bill into multiple payments so my second card would go through.

They even stayed until 10:30 PM, about an hour past closing time, testing the laptop and making sure all my questions were answered.

Honestly, I can’t recommend them enough. There were a lot of hiccups with the payment system and cards, and I probably would have walked out without a laptop (or ended up paying more by not being able to use my credit cards). On top of getting the best price on the laptop, they were also willing to replace the HP wireless mouse with a HyperX Pulsefire Core. So all in all, I walked out with the laptop at the best price along with a complimentary gaming mouse and a bag.
